Information technology – Open Systems Interconnection – The Directory: Protocol specifications
bibdata.abstract: Recommendation ITU-T X.519 | ISO/IEC 9594-5 specifies the Directory Access Protocol, the Directory System Protocol, the Directory Information Shadowing Protocol and the Directory Operational Binding Management Protocol which fulfil the abstract services specified in Recommendation ITU-T X.501 | ISO/IEC 9594-2, Recommendation ITU‑TX.511 | ISO/IEC 9594-3, RecommendationITU-T X.518 | ISO/IEC9594-4 and Recommendation ITU-T X.525 | ISO/IEC9594‑9. It includes specifications for supporting underlying protocols to reduce the dependency on external specifications. The protocols may be encoded using all standard ASN.1 encoding rules.
